newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Dae Won to offer rights and bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Dae Won to offer rights and bonus issue.

text.p: South Korea's Dae Won Cable Co said on Friday it would offer a 39.5-for-100 rights issue in May and a 17-for-100 bonus issue in June to raise operating funds and to help finance facilities investment.
Paid-in capital in the company will rise to 14.15 billion won from 8.10 billion at present.

A Dae Won statement said the company would issue 800,000 new common shares, of which 20 percent would be allocated to its employees. The rest will be offered to shareholders as of April 23 for rights.
The rights issue will be made at a 25 percent discount on the base issue price to be announced later.
Subscription is set for May 22 and 23, with payment due by June 5.
Dae Won will also issue 366,671 new common shares and 44,460 new preferred stocks for a bonus issue. Shareholders registered as of June 7 will be eligible to receive the bonus issue.
Dae Won shares closed 2,800 won higher at 38,900 on Friday.
